newsitem.title: SOMALIA: 26 reported killed in Mogadishu faction fighting.
newsitem.headline: 26 reported killed in Mogadishu faction fighting.

text.p: At least 26 people were killed and 17 wounded in fighting overnight and on Saturday between forces loyal to two Mogadishu faction leaders and self-styled president Hussein Aideed's militiamen, witnesses said.
They said the two allied forces and Hussein Aideed's men fought with mortar bombs, anti-aircraft guns and machineguns on the edge of Medina district in south Mogadishu late on Friday and on Saturday.
Both sides accused the other of starting the fighting that followed more than an hour of clashes in which nine people were killed for control of a base in the northern suburbs of Medina.
Medina is controlled by Moslem fundamentalist forces allied with Osman Hassan Ali Atto, an arch-enemy of the Aideed family.
Hussein Aideed, a 34-year-old former U.S. marine, succeeded his father and was elected president of Somalia by supporters. But he and his government are rejected by many other faction leaders.
